description: Read one 3PL client's onboarding/feed status — use it to verify a publisher is wired up and its feed is flowing (after create_client + inventory/order pushes). Returns the client's config (name, code, management mode, feed source + cadence/staleness windows), readiness signals (itemCount, sourcingProfileCount, activeTokenCount, lastTokenUsedAt), and feed freshness rolled up plus per external warehouse (last inventory/sales-order sync times + counts, last error, fresh/stale/very_stale state; a never-synced feed reads very_stale). An OPERATOR (unpinned) token must pass clientId (any client in the tenant). A client-PINNED token reads only its OWN client: omit clientId to get it, or pass it — passing a different client is refused. 3PL tenants only.

clientId.description: The client id (GUID). Required for an operator token; optional for a client-pinned token (defaults to its own client, and any other id is refused).

name: get_client_onboarding_status
title: Client Onboarding Status
